newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - MARCH 4.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - MARCH 4.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw Stock Exchange was at 16.1 million zlotys on Tuesday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 800 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on June 12, 1998 traded at 94 zlotys.
* 100,434 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on August 6, 1998 traded at 102.6 zlotys.
* 45,750 variable-interest three-year bonds maturing on August 6, 1998 traded at 102.5 zlotys.
